科研.title: A Small Model Asks Better: Fine-Tuning Query Clarification for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.28686v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Query clarification is essential for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that face ambiguous user queries. We consider multi-turn grounded conversational scenarios where a user query is either ill-formed or ambiguous in the context of the prior dialog or, more interestingly, it may be well-formed but when posed against retrieved documents there are multiple relevant interpretations. The task is to recognize both such cases and then generate an appropriate clarification request to the user. We present ClariEdge, a new dataset of approximately 3,900 examples that include such ambiguous queries along with negative examples that do not require clarification. We also show that a lightweight fine-tuned LoRA achieves 96.6% classification accuracy and outperforms prompted baselines of many larger models on both classification and quality of clarification generation. Our study shows that hard negatives are an essential ingredient to separate out queries that are truly ambiguous from queries that may look ambiguous but are not (i.e., can be resolved from the context). The same LoRA achieves high performance in both pre-retrieval and post-retrieval scenarios; thus, it can be used in two places in a RAG pipeline as a check before answer generation. The ClariEdge dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-research/ClariEdge.

科研.title: Scaling in Games: Continued Pre-Training For Embodied Agents In Diverse Virtual Worlds
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.28698v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scaling data, diversity and model capacity has improved embodied learning in physical environments, where diverse experiences remain grounded in shared physical laws. Whether these gains extend to virtual worlds with different visual styles, dynamics, controls, and objectives remains unclear. We investigate this question through a controlled study of continued pre-training (CPT) across three axes: data volume, diversity, and model size. Our 120 training configurations span four model sizes from 0.8B to 27B, six data budgets from 50 to 1,600 hours, and five mixtures ranging from Minecraft-only data to diverse multi-world corpora. We assess performance and generalization using three-level validation losses and gameplay benchmarks from in-corpus worlds to unseen worlds. Our results show: (1) more data improves in-corpus performance, diversity improves transfer to related worlds with limited gains in distant worlds, and model size improves data efficiency but generalizes worse to distant worlds under single-world training; (2) we observe an early interface phase with broad cross-world benefits and a later world phase with gains narrowed to in-corpus and related worlds, and fit an empirical scaling law relating validation loss to data volume, diversity and model size; and (3) our models are competitive with Minecraft specialists and frontier models in 3D worlds, and perform best in real-time settings. However, the limits of imitation and persistent gaps in distant worlds suggest that building generalist embodied agents requires richer training stages beyond continued pre-training.

科研.title: SpecEvo: Speculative Evolution with Large Language Models for Cost-Efficient Scientific Discovery
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.28706v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-driven evolutionary search is a promising paradigm for scientific discovery, but existing methods remain costly and slow, often applying expensive reasoning uniformly while underusing evidence from failed, redundant, and saturated trials. We introduce Speculative Evolution (SpecEvo), a multi-LLM framework that coordinates lightweight and frontier models through continual consolidation of search evidence. Lightweight models power both parallel Speculators, which generate and refine candidate programs, and an Advisor, which distills accumulated successes, failures, and saturated directions into persistent guidance for subsequent exploration. At sparse checkpoints, a frontier-model Navigator inspects the evolving population and intervenes through synthesis, surgical refinement, or reframing according to search stagnation. This speculate-then-consolidate workflow delegates routine exploration and evidence consolidation to inexpensive models while reserving frontier reasoning for strategic interventions whose benefits extend across many subsequent low-cost evaluations. Across 176 tasks spanning four scientific and algorithmic discovery domains, SpecEvo matches or outperforms frontier-model baselines while reducing API cost by up to 80%, achieves up to 1.5x greater evaluation efficiency than cost-efficient baselines on equation discovery, and improves over the strongest CO-Bench baseline by 3.8%. These results support trajectory-conditioned model coordination as an effective approach to cost-efficient scientific discovery.

科研.title: Automating ML for Science: Can Frontier Agents Climb Scientific Hills in the Wild?
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.28763v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Frontier coding agents are increasingly framed as end-to-end automated researchers, and ML for science offers a demanding test of that promise: improving a scientific model often requires domain insight beyond routine ML engineering. We introduce Agent4Sci, a long-horizon testbed for measuring how far today's agents can improve the published best models on scientific ML benchmarks, spanning 20 benchmarks across 11 domains. Rather than ranking agents on a leaderboard, Agent4Sci asks what kinds of progress agents can make on these tasks under in-the-wild conditions, and where they fall short. Empirically, today's frontier agents advance the published best on every benchmark, with Claude Opus reaching 10.4% mean relative improvement and no run flagged for academic misconduct. These gains, however, come almost entirely from a bag of ML-engineering tricks rather than research-level insight. Trajectory analysis surfaces three recurring limitations in this setting: novelty miscalibration, resource under-utilization, and rapid collapse into local engineering sweeps. Lightweight plug-in skills for research ideation, experiment management, and scheduled checklists raise Claude Opus from 10.4% to 20.1% and Codex from 4.4% to 8.1%, while yielding more diverse, domain-relevant interventions. Agent4Sci gives the community a way to track and push frontier agents from ML engineering toward domain insight on real-world ML-for-science problems. Code and data are available on GitHub (https://github.com/maszhongming/agent4sci) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/datasets/MingZhong/agent4sci).

科研.title: MoEZip: Routing-Aware KV Cache Compression for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.30206v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models scale model capacity efficiently by activating a small subset of parameters per token. However, in long-context inference, memory remains a major bottleneck because the KV cache grows linearly with sequence length. Existing KV cache compression methods reduce this cost for dense transformers, but overlook a problem specific to MoE: KV eviction can change which experts are selected during answer generation, degrading the generation quality. We propose MoEZip, a routing-aware KV cache compression for sparse MoE language models. To estimate the sensitivity of expert routing to perturbation, we propose a novel metric based on the Fisher information matrix of routing distributions. MoEZip combines this metric with attention weights for routing-aware scoring of contexts. Finally, we compose a complementary scoring system that combines eviction methods for dense and sparse-MoE architectures. Experiments show that MoEZip achieves robust performance under aggressive cache compression on various benchmarks. At a KV retention ratio of 10\%, MoEZip improves over the SoTA baseline by +24 and +20 points on average on LongBench and RULER, corresponding to 2.3$\times$ and 4.9$\times$ higher scores, respectively.

科研.title: Spectral Uncertainty Decomposition for Sparse Bayesian Learning
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.30207v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Estimating distributed neural sources from M/EEG measurements is an ill-posed inverse problem where principled uncertainty quantification remains challenging. The usual conditional Gaussian posterior covariance does not explicitly distinguish uncertainty along likelihood-visible source directions from uncertainty that is invisible to the measurements. We propose a spectral framework based on the singular value structure of the prior-preconditioned forward operator, which provides an exact, interpretable decomposition of the posterior covariance into data-informed and indeterminacy epistemic components. This formulation identifies uncertainty contributions that are reducible by better measurements from those that are fundamentally irreducible by sensing geometry. We further derive an equivalent subtractive decomposition that expresses the prior covariance as the sum of posterior and data-driven reduction terms, enabling precise accounting of uncertainty reduction through Bayesian learning. Together, these complementary representations offer both theoretical insight and practical tools for interpretable uncertainty quantification in M/EEG source imaging for linear-Gaussian Bayesian inverse solvers where the posterior covariance is available in closed form.

科研.title: Prediction Is Not Calibration: Item Parameter Recovery and Representation Coupling in Knowledge Tracing
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.30211v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Knowledge tracing (KT) models can estimate item parameters through an item response decoder trained solely for next-response prediction, yet predictive accuracy does not guarantee parameter recovery. We study 2PL, GPCM, and NRM decoders paired with LSTM, Transformer, and DKVMN encoders. Response-model derivatives show why discrimination and option slope updates depend directly on the scale and spread of estimated ability. Affine logit identities show how item-dependent shifts and rescaling in estimated ability are absorbed into item parameters without changing response probabilities. In simulations, difficulty, mean threshold, and correct-option intercept recovery remain high under shuffled order across representation widths, whereas discrimination and keyed option slope contrast recovery require wider item representations and degrade further under fixed item order. Separating the sequence item representation (width $d_S$) from the item parameter key (width $d_M$), and pairing a wide key with a thin sequence representation ($\mathrm{SK}(64,8)$), reduces fixed-order ability distortions and improves recovery and cross-order consistency without sacrificing test accuracy or increasing model size relative to a shared width-64 baseline ($\mathrm{SH}(64)$). On TIMSS and EdNet, widening $d_M$ consistently improves agreement with an offline IRT reference, while the trade-off from narrowing $d_S$ depends on the encoder's reliance on sequence width for prediction. These findings show why item parameters, especially discrimination and option slopes, must be evaluated separately from response prediction.

科研.title: AI Mindmeld: A Latent Interconnect Protocol
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.30215v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLMs can act as scientific agents using tools to consult specialists and run experiments. Yet specialist information must enter their context, generally as text, images, audio or video: a bottleneck between models with rich, high-dimensional representations. We advocate direct representation exchange: a mindmeld conveying many properties, including information an LLM would not think to request. It should be extensible to new specialists, flexible across questions and tasks, and compositional across independently connected specialists without joint training. The Latent Interconnect Protocol (LIP) learns connectors mapping specialist representations into LLM internal states. Training only connectors keeps this practical as LLMs grow and evolve. We connect three protein and three small molecule specialists to Gemma 3 (4B and 12B parameters) and Kimi K2.6 (1T total, 32B active), freezing all pretrained models. Independently trained connectors provide useful information without changing the LLM or existing connectors, supporting familiar and new question types about unseen objects. We demonstrate zero-shot transfer to cross-domain tasks without joint training. Task performance and compositionality generally improve with LLM capability, with especially strong gains in zero-shot task transfer. Limitations remain: current LLMs were not trained for specialist representations as native inputs; access does not ensure reliable interpretation, integration or use in reasoning. We call on specialist developers to provide consistent representation interfaces and, especially, on LLM developers to train models to receive, combine and reason with these inputs. These efforts could expand scientific agents' information while preserving conventional tools' flexibility. Data, pretrained connectors, and code for training, evaluation and interactive inference: https://github.com/PolymathicAI/AI-Mindmeld

科研.title: Electronic Screening as a Design Lever in La-Doped BaTiO$_3$: Coupled Polarization, Dielectric Response, and Optical Anisotropy
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.30210v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Donor substitution can tune the coupled ferroelectric, dielectric, electronic, and optical properties of perovskite oxides by modifying lattice distortions and electronic screening. We investigate these effects in La-doped BaTiO3 using density functional theory, density-functional perturbation theory, and the Berry-phase formalism for polarization. For a model with 12.5% La substitution at the Ba site, La incorporation induces anisotropic lattice contraction, reduces tetragonality and Ti off-centering, and weakens the energetic stabilization of the tetragonal ferroelectric phase. The accompanying reduction in polarization is associated with enhanced electronic screening and reduced anomalous Born effective charges. Phonon calculations indicate that the relaxed doped structure is dynamically stable, while hardening of a low-frequency polar mode is consistent with weakened ferroelectricity. The high-frequency dielectric response increases moderately, whereas the static dielectric response decreases as the lattice contribution is suppressed. Electronic-structure calculations show a Fermi-level shift toward the conduction band without mid-gap defect states. The optical spectra exhibit an absorption-edge shift consistent with a Burstein-Moss-type mechanism, enhanced near-edge transparency, and reduced birefringence. Together, these results suggest a microscopic connection between donor-induced screening, polar-mode hardening, reduced dynamical charges, polarization suppression, and decreased optical anisotropy. The conclusions apply to the investigated 12.5% composition; calculations at additional concentrations are needed to establish quantitative doping trends.

科研.title: Domain walls in $R3c$-structured NaNbO$_3$
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.30318v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we undertake a systematic first-principles study of structural domain walls in the low-temperature rhombohedral $R3c$ phase of perovskite oxide NaNbO$_3$. Employing a group-theoretic classification, we introduce eight unique classes of domain walls in the $R3c$ structure, four of which have a domain wall orientation determined uniquely by the conditions of elastic compatibility and charge neutrality, and perform structural relaxations for each representative domain wall class. We find that one class of 109{\deg} domain walls has a notably low energy of 9 mJ m$^{-2}$, comparable to the low-energy ferroelectric walls in BaTiO$_3$. Finally, we find that this class of 109{\deg} walls is compatible with the crystal twinning observed in experiments on the $R3c$ phase, and propose an atomistic mechanism for the $R3c \leftrightarrow Pbcm$ phase transition.

科研.title: Peridynamic Thermo-Mechanical Modeling of Cracking in Tungsten under Fusion-Relevant Heat Fluxes
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.30356v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Plasma-facing materials (PFMs) are the primary armor materials in fusion reactors, protecting reactor wall components from extreme heat fluxes, energetic particles, and intense neutron irradiation. These harsh conditions induce thermo-mechanical stresses, irradiation damage, and overall degradation in PFMs. Among these, thermo-mechanical damage induced by extreme heat flux is one of the key factors limiting the lifetime of PFMs. We present a modeling and simulation approach for predicting thermo-mechanical cracking and damage in tungsten, a leading PFM candidate, under fusion-reactor-relevant heat fluxes. Specifically, we study damage induced by cyclic electron beam (e-beam) exposure under different combinations of base temperature and heat flux. We carry out component-scale thermo-mechanical simulations using CabanaPD, a peridynamics fracture mechanics code, informed by experimental data for recrystallized pure tungsten from the JUDITH e-beam facility. The simulations compare well with the experimental classification and enable identification of cracking thresholds across a range of heat fluxes and base temperatures. These predictions can provide detailed insights into the spatial distribution and temporal accumulation of cracks and damage, while offering a pathway for screening candidate PFMs and quantifying their lifespan under fusion-relevant conditions.

科研.title: Microstructural Generative Inverse Models for Additive Manufacturing Digital Twins
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.30404v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Metal additive manufacturing (AM) offers substantial advantages to the fabrication of complex structural components, but its widespread adoption is slowed due to complexities in the process-structure-property relations which is the cause for uncertainty and drives risk. Accurately quantifying these complex relations solely via experimental workflows is time consuming and costly. Integrated computational materials and engineering (ICME) frameworks address this challenge by leveraging advanced computational tools, such as crystal plasticity finite element models (CPFEM), to predict critical mechanical properties directly from microstructural data. However, these frameworks require a large datasets that are often difficult to obtain, and their predictive accuracy depends on the availability of realistic AM microstructure representations. Generative deep learning models are a promising approach towards synthesizing AM microstructures which contain complex morphological and crystallographic features. Denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs), in particular, show a strong potential to capture the inherent complexities of AM structures. In this work, we demonstrate that DDPMs can reliably synthesize digital-twin orientation-imaging micrographs, and we support this claim with quantitative evidence of the fidelity of the generated samples. Additionally, we establish a classifier-free guidance framework for solving complex inverse problems such as property-to-structure and process-to-structure mappings, and we showcase a potential application on a qualification-relevant uncertainty quantification problem. Our work highlights the potential of AI-based generative modeling as a key component of computational frameworks for accelerating AM materials qualification and certification.

科研.title: Phase-Matched Chirps for Energy-Efficient Excitation of Magneto-Mechanical Resonators
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.31296v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magneto-mechanical resonators (MMRs) are a recently proposed class of passive, wireless devices used for sensing and tracking. The operating principle of MMRs relies on an excitation of the sensor by oscillating magnetic fields, followed by an inductive readout to measure the sensor's dynamics. One challenge lies in generating efficient excitation signals to ensure maximum energy harvesting by the sensor. In this simulation study, we focus on chirped magnetic-field excitations and compare their performance with conventional constant-frequency excitation for both sinusoidal and rectangular waveforms. The results indicate varying levels of efficiency, with a sinusoidal linear down-chirp excitation signal yielding the largest deflection angle, offering the best potential for reducing the energy consumption and improving the temporal resolution of the measurement.

科研.title: Orbital-coherence memory in electrical transport and its self-consistent Maxwell response
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.31390v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An internal electronic coherence changes electrical transport only when it feeds back on the physical current. We develop a reduced description of this feedback and distinguish its exact consequences from the assumptions required for a microscopic realization. An opposite-parity two-orbital Hamiltonian identifies a current-coupled orbital force. Under an explicitly stated moment closure and collision ansatz, it yields a passive three-state response with an exponentially damped oscillatory memory. The resulting conductivity redistributes a fixed optical weight and predicts a nonmonotonic dependence of dc conduction on coherence damping at fixed remaining parameters. The orbital reduction constrains the coupling and internal frequency through a shared bare splitting, providing a test beyond unconstrained spectral fitting. A charge-conserving spatial extension couples to Maxwell equations through a positive energy balance and separates the constitutive response from longitudinal collective and transverse electromagnetic modes. We formulate complex-conductivity and transmission tests, including the limits of parameter identification over a finite bandwidth. The model supplies a conditional connection between orbital dynamics, transport memory, and electromagnetic observables; conductivity alone does not establish a uniquely quantum mechanism, and a material-specific collision calculation and closure-error assessment remain necessary.

科研.title: Analytical Modeling of Modulated Heating for Three-Dimensional Anisotropic Optical Thermometry of Multilayered Cylinders
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.31424v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thermally relevant cylindrical geometries are used in a plethora of applications with thermal property differences depending significantly on material complexity. Manu- facturing processes also induce substantial anisotropy ratios resulting in directionally dependent thermal transport. However, for cylindrical specimens, current thermal metrology resolves only isotropic thermal properties, assumes perfect thermal inter- faces, and offers no formulation for temperature spatial dependence. In this work, we present an analytical framework that models the frequency dependent thermal transport of orthotropic arbitrary layered cylinders to be used as a forward model for existing optical thermometry techniques. This formulation captures the effects of non-negligible thermal boundary conductance and offers the first closed-form solution of a projected Gaussian laser, a common form of heating in thermal metrology, hav- ing a finite elliptic spot size on a curved surface. The novel anisotropic cylindrical model was compared with literature derivations involving two-dimensional isotropic transport for cylinders by applying simplifying assumptions. For single- and two- layerisotropicsamples, thethree-dimensionalmodelagreedwithestablishedsolutions with negligible error, while predictions for orthotropic multilayer samples agreed with finite-element simulations within 1.5% across a range of material properties and laser geometries. Comparison with anisotropic planar models identified conditions under which a planar approximation can reduce computation time. These results estab- lish the first forward model for noncontact characterization of anisotropic thermal properties in arbitrarily layered cylinders.

科研.title: Einstein's theory of Brownian motion: The non-Fickian normal diffusion
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.30194v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Einstein's theory of diffusion defines what is considered {\it normal diffusion}. Historically, Einstein considered homogeneous diffusion characterised by a diffusion constant in his original calculations, resulting in what is known as {\it Fickian} diffusion, which thermally relaxes concentration inhomogeneities. However, in the same derivation of Einstein, the seed of generalisation of the theory to {\it non-Fickian} diffusion in the presence of space-dependent diffusivity is hidden. This indicates that non-Fickian diffusion, which can drive concentration inhomogeneities, can also be normal diffusion. The present article discusses the origin of the {\it normal} non-Fickian diffusion in Einstein's theory of diffusion.

科技.summary: IT之家 10 月 23 日消息，科技媒体 9to5Mac 昨日（10 月 22 日）发布博文，报道称复古游戏模拟器 Delta 更新至 2.0 版本， 在适配苹果首款折叠 iPhone Duo 之外，在界面上融入了液态玻璃（Liquid Glass）设计。 在游戏体验方面，Delta 针对 iPhone Duo 的多种使用姿势，设计了专属虚拟手柄皮肤，其中最值得关注的是任天堂 DS 布局。应用可充分利用内屏尺寸，在竖向“书本模式”下跨越折叠铰链，把上半屏作为游戏画面、下半屏作为触控操作区，还原真实 DS 的双屏体验。IT之家附上相关图片如下： 在横屏分屏场景中，Delta 也做了一个巧妙设计。通常 iPhone Duo 的分屏会将两个应用各限制在约一半屏幕内，但 Delta 把虚拟 DS 的下半屏以自定义键盘视图呈现，让操作区可横跨整个屏幕宽度，甚至覆盖分屏另一侧的视频应用。这意味着用户可以一边看视频，一边在下方完整操作游戏。 在适配 iPhone Duo 之外，Delta 2.0 还兼容支持 Sega Genesis ROM，改进了游戏库导航，并更新音频设置，允许游戏声音与正在播放的音乐或播客混合输出。高级版可通过 App Store 内购订阅解锁，现已面向全球推出。

科技.summary: IT之家 10 月 23 日消息，近日， PHP 曝出存在 CVE-2026-109618 和 CVE-2026-109619 两个远程代码执行超危漏洞 ，危害严重。此次漏洞可能允许未经身份验证的攻击者远程执行代码，进而篡改网站内容、读取敏感数据或入侵服务器。PHP 基金会已于 10 月 21 日发布紧急安全更新，修复版本包括 PHP 8.5.12、8.4.27、8.3.36 和 8.2.35。 美国音响品牌 Sonos 中国团队今日（10 月 23 日）发布公告，受 PHP 全球安全漏洞影响，为保障用户的数据安全，Sonos 正在推送安全更新， 在 Sonos App 内暂停使用网易云音乐、QQ 音乐、酷狗音乐、酷我音乐 。 Sonos 中国团队表示，相关服务预计会在 未来几天内恢复 。恢复后用户可能需要重新授权音乐服务账号，即可继续使用。用户在音乐服务账号里的收藏、自建歌单不会丢失，无需更改密码或重装 App。 综合IT之家此前报道，PHP 是一款广泛用于 Web 开发的开源服务器端脚本语言。由于其存在两个超危远程代码执行漏洞，未经身份验证的攻击者可利用其远程执行任意代码，造成服务器受控、敏感信息泄露、业务中断等危害。受影响的 PHP 范围包括：8.5 系列＜8.5.12、8.4 系列＜8.4.27、8.3 系列＜8.3.36、8.2 系列＜8.2.35、8.1 系列及更早版本。

科技.summary: IT之家 10 月 23 日消息，在第四期 Power On 播客节目中，彭博社的马克 · 古尔曼（Mark Gurman）透露， 苹果公司正在规划更大尺寸的 iPhone Duo，并考虑在未来机型中加入长焦摄像头。 IT之家附上相关播客视频如下： 古尔曼在播客节目中表示，这些规划有望在第三代 iPhone Duo 上实现，该产品预估 2028 年推出，其内屏尺寸可能比现款（7.6 英寸）增加约 0.5 英寸， 达到“8 英寸出头”的水平。 古尔曼表示， 苹果 iPhone Duo 屏幕尺寸的升级路线，不会推出 8.5 英寸或者 9 英寸的大型折叠屏幕，会采用类似 Pro 系列的渐进式扩屏策略。例如 iPhone 15 Pro Max 从 6.7 英寸增至 iPhone 16 Pro Max 的 6.9 英寸。 影像方面，古尔曼透露长焦“已在苹果的计划清单中”，但尚未确定具体落地时间。他表示，难点不在成本，主要在物理结构，由于折叠机身内部空间有限，长焦模组所需的镜头深度难以容纳。 此外， 古尔曼还提到苹果正在测试 iPhone Duo 2 的外屏下 Face ID ，并探索加入操作按钮（Action Button）的可能性。若上述升级成真，iPhone Duo 后续机型将同时向“更大内屏、更强影像、更完整交互”方向演进。 相关阅读： 《 古尔曼：苹果正测试第二代 iPhone Duo 原型机，配备面容 ID 》

科技.title: DeepSeek 据悉完成 1000 亿元新一轮融资；特斯拉三季度利润大跌 43%；微信称已完成适配 iPhone Duo | 极客早知道
科技.summary: DeepSeek 新一轮融资筹得约 1000 亿 10 月 22 日，有市场消息称，国内大模型公司 DeepSeek 拟在最新一轮融资中筹得约 1000 亿元人民币 ( 约 150 亿美元 )，腾讯和宁德时代为本轮出资最多的投资方，交易预计在未来数日内正式完成。 截至目前，DeepSeek 及腾讯等相关投资方均未公开回应。记者从接近公司和投资方的多个信源交叉求证，确认上述消息属实。 消息人士透露，本轮募资目标最初设定为 500 亿元，此后经多轮上调至约 1000 亿元，目前尚未官宣，最终金额仍未完全确定。 这笔资金将继续用于模型训练、算力建设和人才招募，以支撑 DeepSeek 参与全球竞争。也有部分消息人士判断，本轮融资将为公司筹备中的科创板 IPO 铺平道路。（来源：上海证券报） SpaceX 据报洽谈接入美国至少 8 万座基站，准备建立全国性移动通信网络 据彭博社 10 月 22 日报道，SpaceX 正在与美国移动通信基础设施企业洽谈，希望获得至少 8 万座地面通信站点的使用权。 这项计划可能帮助 SpaceX 建立覆盖美国全国的移动通信网络，进一步拓展 Starlink 的业务范围。 过去，Starlink 主要通过卫星提供宽带互联网服务，并逐步发展卫星直连手机业务。如果 SpaceX 能够获得大量地面通信站点的使用权，就有机会将卫星通信与传统地面移动网络结合。 目前相关合作仍处于谈判阶段，尚未公布最终协议。（来源：彭博社） Anthropic 冲刺史上规模最大 IPO 10 月 22 日，据财联社援引知情人士消息，Anthropic 最快将于当地时间本周五向美国 SEC 公开提交 S-1 招股说明书，这是这家 AI 公司冲刺史上规模最大 IPO 的核心程序性节点。 早在今年 6 月，Anthropic 就已秘密提交 IPO 草案，此前一个月完成的 650 亿美元 H 轮融资，也为上市奠定了资本基础。该轮融资投后估值达 9650 亿美元，由 Altimeter Capital、Dragoneer、Greenoaks 和红杉资本领投。Anthropic 的估值也超越 OpenAI，后者在今年 3 月的投后估值为 8520 亿美元。 很长一段时间里，华尔街主流机构的乐观预期是，Anthropic 有望以 2 万亿美元估值上市，募资规模最高可达 1000 亿美元，直接刷新今年 6 月 SpaceX 创下的 IPO 纪录。SpaceX 上市时估值约 1.77 万亿美元，募资约 857 亿美元。（来源：界面新闻） 腾讯客服称微信目前已适配 iPhone Duo，后续还会推出相关更新并持续提升使用体验 10 月 22 日消息，苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 已于 10 月 16 日晚 8 点开启预购，搭载 A20 Pro 处理器，国行定价 15,999 元起。 关于微信的适配情况一直是大家重点关心的问题，腾讯客服表示： 微信目前已经适配苹果折叠屏手机，您可以正常下载使用微信。同时微信团队正在积极推进对苹果可折叠设备的适配优化，后续会推出相关更新并持续提升使用体验。请您放心使用当前版本。 另外，微信输入法也已更新 4.0.0 版本，宣布全面适配 iPhone Duo。（来源：IT 之家） 特斯拉三季度净利润大跌 43%，交付量降至 48.65 万辆 10 月 22 日消息，特斯拉于当地时间周三美股盘后发布 2026 年第三季度财报。数据显示，公司当季营收为 280.46 亿美元，与上年同期的 280.95 亿美元基本持平；GAAP 净利润为 7.87 亿美元，同比下降 43%。 按非 GAAP 口径计算，特斯拉三季度净利润为 16.97 亿美元，同比下降 4%；调整后每股收益为 0.48 美元，同比下降 4%。 盈利能力方面，特斯拉三季度营业利润为 7.18 亿美元，同比大幅下降 56%，营业利润率由上年同期的 5.8% 降至 2.6%。运营支出同比增长 39% 至 47.76 亿美元，主要受到超级智能及其他研发项目、股权激励费用和一般行政开支增加的影响。值得一提的是，公司整体毛利率同比提升 1.6 个百分点至 19.6%。 分业务来看，汽车业务营收为 205.60 亿美元，同比下降 3%；能源生产与储能业务营收为 28.81 亿美元，同比下降 16%，部分受到关税相关客户退款影响；服务及其他业务营收则同比增长 33% 至 46.05 亿美元。 交付数据方面，三季度特斯拉汽车交付量为 486,532 辆，同比下降 2%；产量为 464,391 辆，同比增长 4%。储能产品部署量达到 13.7GWh，同比增长 10%；完全自动驾驶（FSD）活跃订阅量达到 174 万，同比增长 67%。 特斯拉表示，将继续推进 Cybercab、Optimus 人形机器人及储能业务扩张，并计划于 2026 年底前将超级智能训练算力提升至 400 兆瓦。公司预计，未来硬件业务利润将逐步获得超级智能、软件及车队运营业务利润增长的支持。（来源：TechWeb） 曝第二代 iPhoneDuo 配备面容 ID 苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 没有配备 Face ID 面容解锁，成为新机备受讨论的设计遗憾之一。 目前，iPhone Duo 采用集成在侧边按键上的 Touch ID 指纹识别。 对于习惯使用面容解锁的用户来说，这一变化多少有些不适应。影视飓风创始人 Tim 在 iPhone Duo 深度评测中也直言，没有面容解锁是他认为这款手机最大的遗憾。 如今，苹果似乎正准备弥补这一短板。 据知名科技记者马克·古尔曼在最新一期《Power On》播客中透露，苹果正在测试新一代 iPhone Duo 原型机，其中已经包含屏下 Face ID 技术。 据悉，相关方案计划将 Face ID 硬件隐藏在外屏下方，在尽可能保持屏幕完整性的同时，实现面容识别功能。 不过，这项技术目前仍处于原型机测试阶段，苹果尚未最终确定是否会在正式量产机型上采用。 初代 iPhone Duo 之所以没有配备 Face ID，与折叠屏手机特殊的内部结构有一定关系。 折叠屏手机需要在有限的机身空间内同时容纳铰链、双屏、电池等组件，内部堆叠更加紧凑，也给 Face ID 所需的传感器布局带来了挑战。 最终，苹果选择将 Touch ID 集成到侧边按键中，以兼顾机身设计与解锁体验。 如果屏下 Face ID 最终落地，iPhone Duo 2 有望补齐初代机型在解锁体验上的短板，弥补不少用户眼中的最大遗憾。（来源：快科技） 宇树十周年王兴兴呼吁相信 AI，预判物理 AI「GPT 时刻」临近 10 月 22 日，宇树科技在杭州举办世界物理 AI 大会，恰逢公司创立十周年。创始人王兴兴在演讲中重点谈及 AI，坦言自己过往对 AI 的相信程度不足，呼吁业界重视 AI 潜力，并压缩了具身智能拐点的预期窗口，判断物理 AI 的「GPT 时刻」大概率在 1 至 3 年内到来，家用指令式做家务机器人最快明年有望落地。 王兴兴表示，宇树不会和头部大厂正面竞争基础大模型，将采用自研 + 外部合作路线。现场演示了 GPT-6 直连机器人、零训练完成绘画、落子等任务；他认为导航规划等问题已基本解决，当前核心瓶颈是模型输出和机器人传感器、执行器误差的对齐。在战略上，宇树将硬件大规模制造能力放在首位，目标冲击年产千万台，同时搭建 AI 自进化闭环。 产品端，G1 人形机器人已是全球同型号出货量最高机型，H2-X 机器人在力量、续航、动作能力上持续升级。本届大会展区内机器人密集，导览、巡逻、教育是当前主要落地场景。大会还启动世界物理 AI 大赛，拿出数千万奖金扶持全球开发者，为机器人行业储备人才。现场读者留言则集中期待家务、养老陪护类机器人尽快落地。（来源：极客公园） 相关报道： 宇树 10 周年，王兴兴：我劝你相信 AI 比尔 · 盖茨：人们要为 AI 带来的二十年颠覆性变革做好准备 10 月 22 日消息，微软联合创始人、亿万富翁慈善家比尔 · 盖茨今日接受外媒 The Verge 采访。他表示，人们要为 AI 带来的二十年颠覆性变革做好准备，这段时期可能会非常痛苦，甚至会将社会分裂成两派：一派乐于接受前沿科技，另一派拒绝。 比尔 · 盖茨今年 8 月发表一篇文章，认为人们向 AI 时代过渡时，将经历一段动荡时期。此后他将 AI 称为「人类有史以来接触过最危险的东西」，并认为 AI 让核武器相形见绌。 盖茨表示，他并非 AI 悲观主义者。他认为 AI 过去一年的进步令人惊叹，从编写代码和发现网络漏洞的能力，到生物学推理能力，再到颠覆就业市场的能力，无不体现着这一点。如今人类拥有的强大力量，意味着上述所有事情都将成为现实，社会必须做好准备。 谈到刚刚说的「二十年动荡时期」时盖茨认为，那时候物资短缺的情况将会减少，人们必须找到掌控局面的方法。这期间将会有输家和赢家，也会有很多动荡，人们必须挺过这段时间才能迎来繁荣时代。 在那段时间，人类将拥有可以建造房屋、种植食物、进行手术的机器人，绝大多数商品和服务都不再需要人类劳动力。因此人们必须思考自己如何度过这 20 年，并思考哲学、社会行为等深刻问题。 当然，盖茨这番话并不是说二十年后世界就一定不太平，他认为这个时间可能早几年或晚几年。并且突破类的成就谁也说不准，例如人形机器人能力进步，有的人说两三年就行，有的人则说八年左右才能实现。（来源：IT 之家） 1Password 推出 AI Agent 登录方案：智能体可以操作账号，但看不到密码 密码管理服务商 1Password 推出 1Password for Agents，允许 AI Agent 在不直接读取用户密码的情况下，登录需要身份验证的网站和服务。 根据产品介绍，当 AI Agent 需要登录某个账号时，1Password 会向用户的设备发送授权请求。用户确认后，系统通过安全机制完成登录，Agent 不需要获取或保存账号密码。 这套方案面向越来越多能够自主操作浏览器和应用的 AI 产品，包括 ChatGPT Work、Dots、Claude Duet 和 Meta Muse 等。 与直接向 AI 提供账号密码相比，这种方式能够减少凭据暴露风险，并让用户保留对登录操作的控制权。（来源：The Verge） 王腾官宣今日宜休第二款产品智能温控系统，将于 10 月 29 日亮相 继智能戒指之后，王腾创办的今日宜休又公布了一款睡眠科技新品。日前，王腾通过社交平台官宣，ISHO iFlow 智能温控系统将于 10 月 29 日召开的今日宜休 AI 睡眠科技生态产品发布会上正式亮相。 根据官宣信息，ISHO iFlow 是今日宜休公布的第二款产品，主打智能温控，面向深睡和精力恢复需求。品牌方以「从无感监测到睡眠干预」介绍其产品方向，并将其作为 AI 睡眠科技生态的重要组成部分。不过，此次预告尚未披露产品的具体形态、温控方式、售价及开售时间。 从已公布的信息看，今日宜休的产品布局正从穿戴设备延伸至睡眠环境。此前亮相的 ISHO Ring 智能戒指与此次公布的 iFlow 智能温控系统，将如何协同，也是发布会的一大看点。 今日宜休规划推出覆盖智能穿戴、卧室睡眠干预两大品类的硬件产品，通过穿戴设备感知用户身体状态，由卧室睡眠干预硬件调整睡眠环境，再结合 AI 与用户反馈，提供个性化建议及协同策略，配套 App 作为统一入口。（来源：极目新闻） 利用酒店 Wi-Fi 发送约 48 万条钓鱼邮件，日本警方在酒店客房冰箱后发现隐藏电脑 10 月 22 日消息，据 TomsHardware 今日报道，日本兵库县警方 10 月 15 日逮捕了一对外国籍夫妇。两人涉嫌利用酒店 Wi-Fi 发送钓鱼邮件，并被指控盗用他人信用卡。 警方在涉案电脑中发现约 48 万条钓鱼邮件发送记录，以及约 240 万个电子邮件地址。 报道称，涉案男子于 2025 年 5 月 15 日涉嫌伪装成酒店住客，将一台电脑藏在神户市一家酒店客房的冰箱后方，并将其连接至酒店 Wi-Fi，然后冒充信用卡公司发送钓鱼邮件，引导收件人访问钓鱼网站，从而获取其信用卡信息。 警方认为，邮件可能由其他人员远程操控涉案电脑发送。由于电脑使用酒店网络，相关邮件的网络信息指向酒店。直到有收件人联系酒店反映可疑邮件，工作人员才发现藏在冰箱后方的设备，并向警方报案。警方目前仍在调查这对夫妇是否独立实施相关行为，或是受其他人员指使。 日媒报道显示，警方尚未公布二人对相关指控的具体回应，并怀疑可能还有其他人员参与其中。目前，调查重点包括涉案电脑的远程操控者身份、信用卡信息来源，以及这对夫妇是否与更大规模的诈骗团伙存在联系。（来源：IT 之家）

科技.title: 欧洲 AI，等来了黄仁勋
科技.summary: GTC 柏林开幕前的两周，半导体板块走得并不顺，费城半导体指数出现了 2008 年以来最长的一轮连跌。市场在反复算同一笔账，巨额的 GPU 投入，什么时候能变成实打实的回报。 10 月 21 日，在柏林 Tempodrom 的舞台上，黄仁勋没有发布新芯片。早已发布的 Vera Rubin 平台，这次只是确认「已全面量产」。他把更多时间留给了三个更落地的问题： 算力中心怎么建得更快，越来越能干的智能体怎么管住，物理 AI，怎么走进欧洲的工厂和马路 。 用他自己的话说，「我们正处于人类历史上最大规模的基础设施建设之中」，需求不缺，缺的是产能和落地速度。 在英伟达 GTC 柏林大会之前，黄仁勋和德国总理默茨的对谈走红社交平台，当下 AI 基建绝对王者告诉后者，面对汹涌而至的全新生产力革命，「紧箍咒」可能并不是最优解。 把 AI 工厂装进集装箱 过去两年，建一座 AI 数据中心更像一场土木工程。服务器、网络、供电和液冷要在现场逐一安装、布线、调试，一个大型集群从设备进场到真正点亮，拖上大半年是常态。而模型公司的迭代是按周算的，晚一个月拿到算力，可能就晚了一个版本。 英伟达在柏林给出的答案是 DSX POD。大屏上的标语很直白，「 集装箱就是 AI 工厂 」。 它是一套完整 Vera Rubin AI 工厂的模块化参考设计。一套 DSX POD 由 7 个液冷计算机架组成，内部约 17 公里线缆互连，采用 800V 直流供电，计算、网络、供电和液冷都在工厂里集成、测试完毕，再装进集装箱运到现场。戴尔、HPE、联想、施耐德电气、维谛，以及鸿海、广达、纬创等厂商参与制造，预计 2027 年初开始交付。 按照官方的说法，在现场电力、冷却和网络已经就绪的前提下，部署时间可以从约 6 个月缩短到最快 14 天。 只看建设速度，其实低估了这件事。黄仁勋把 AI 经济比作五层蛋糕，最底下一层是能源。 当算力规模越做越大，真正卡脖子的已经不只是芯片，而是电。 所以和 DSX POD 一起发布的，还有两套用电工具。DSX MaxLPS 在 GPU 之间动态分配功率，官方称在产出同样多 Token 的情况下，功耗最多能降低 30%，换个角度说，同样的电力额度里能塞进更多 GPU。DSX Flex 则让数据中心和电网联动，按电价和供电状况调整负载，在模拟电网事件的早期测试里，一个 Blackwell Ultra 集群的用电负荷最多降了 40%。冷却改用闭环液冷加室外干式冷却器，减少冷却塔的蒸发耗水。 英伟达投资的欧洲数据中心开发商 Nscale 给了一组早期数据，在 GB300 NVL72 上，同样的电力预算下多部署了 37% 的 GPU，总推理吞吐提升近 50%。 这套逻辑的落点很清楚， 衡量 AI 工厂的指标，正在从「有多少卡」变成「每度电产出多少 Token」 。 当然也有官方没说的部分。14 天的前提是电力和场地已经到位，而从公开信息来看，欧洲不少地区的电网接入本身就要排很久。DSX POD 的价格、总拥有成本也还没有公布，集装箱方案能帮客户省下多少钱，要等首批项目交付后才见分晓。 给智能体装上硬件刹车 如果说 DSX POD 解决的是「建得快」，OpenShell 企业参考架构要解决的是「用得放心」。 今年的智能体已经不只待在对话框里，它们开始读写文件、调用工具、访问企业系统。权限越大，风险越大，近期 AI 圈就出现过智能体擅自关闭安全监控的事件。 黄仁勋在台上说得很直接，「最重要的是确保智能体是安全的」。智能体的权限要降到最低，并持续监控，而且「每次启动智能体，权限都不一样」，所以管控也得跟着动态调整。他把 OpenShell 称为英伟达做过最重要的事情之一。 OpenShell 本身在 6 月的 GTC 就已推出，是一个开源、按策略控制的运行时，用内核级沙箱把智能体和它能影响的系统隔开。这次发布的，是在英伟达全栈硬件上怎么部署它的企业级方案。 分工是这样的，Vera Rubin GPU 负责模型推理，Vera CPU 承载智能体的运行框架和工具调用，OpenShell 划定隔离和权限边界，BlueField-4 DPU 上则跑着英伟达的 Sentry 安全框架。黄仁勋的概括是，智能体在 Rubin 上思考，在 Vera 上行动，在 BlueField 上被管住。 这套设计的意义在于，安全边界不再只依赖模型「自觉」或软件层的护栏。 模型遇到提示词注入时，软件防线可能失守，而跑在 DPU 上的管控独立于智能体本身。英伟达称，智能体一旦越界，Sentry 能在毫秒级把它隔离并叫停，这一点还有待第三方验证。 合作名单相当长，Anthropic、OpenAI、微软、谷歌云、AWS、SAP、ServiceNow、CrowdStrike、Palo Alto、摩根大通都在大屏上。ServiceNow 已经可以用自家治理平台制定权限、由 OpenShell 执行，并能快速撤销智能体的访问权。不过多数安全厂商仍处在集成阶段，一些银行还在评估。 另一面也要看到，完整的参考架构建立在英伟达自家的 GPU、CPU 和 DPU 之上。对企业来说，获得硬件级安全的同时，也意味着和英伟达全栈绑得更紧。 物理 AI 在欧洲 把 GTC 放在柏林，很大程度上是冲着欧洲的工业底子来的。黄仁勋这次说，「Robotaxi 是机器人和物理 AI 第一个大众市场应用。」 最具体的一单来自欧洲出行平台 Bolt。它选用英伟达的 Alpamayo 技术栈开发 Robotaxi，计划获批后 2027 年先在马德里采集道路数据，目标是在欧洲部署至少 2.5 万辆基于 Hyperion 平台、具备 L4 能力的 Lucid 车辆，德国是重点市场之一。沃尔沃也宣布采用 Hyperion 和 Alpamayo，黄仁勋还提到，奔驰、大众商用车和捷豹路虎的下一代车型将兼容 Hyperion。 车端的新模型是 Alpamayo 2 Edge，20 亿参数，针对 DRIVE AGX Thor 芯片优化，每秒运行 10 次，负责理解路况和规划运动。配套的 Halos SAFE 把仿真、软硬件测试、道路测试和车队监控串起来，帮车企积累可追溯的安全证据，这恰恰是自动驾驶在欧洲拿牌照绕不开的一环。 人形机器人这边，德国思灵机器人推出了 Agile ONE SN 参考平台。它高 1.4 米、重 40 千克，本体 31 个自由度，两只五指灵巧手各有 20 个自由度，由 Jetson Thor 驱动，跑英伟达的 Isaac GR00T 模型，2027 年初推出。Agility Robotics、Figure、库卡等公司在同一套平台上开发。 英伟达对这个平台的定位相当克制。它承认人形机器人的开发门槛依然很高，目前基本是资金雄厚的公司才玩得转。Agile ONE SN 加上新的 Isaac OS、Isaac Lab 3.0 和仿真资产库，目标是把研究人员搭建和配置的时间从几周缩到几天，但这并不等于机器人已经能在产线上稳定干活。 工业现场的演示也是同样的思路。西门子埃尔朗根工厂让智能体先在数字孪生里验证新品投产方案，达索系统展示了智能体把大众高尔夫的车门设计改到途观上，仿真发现振动问题后继续迭代，最后交给工程师拍板。 物理 AI 在欧洲的切入点很务实，先进入最耗工程师时间的仿真和测试环节，而不是急着替换产线。 演讲临近结束，四只 Microduck 小机器鸭走上了舞台。它们听指令坐下、站起、趴下「睡午觉」，有一只没跟上节奏，绊了一下又自己爬起来，黄仁勋连声招呼它「集中精神，过来」，全场都笑了。他对这几只小鸭子说，它们在 RTX Spark 上诞生，在云端的英伟达超级计算机上训练，又在数字孪生里学会了技能。 这几只摇摇晃晃的机器鸭，恰好是这场演讲的缩影。AI 从芯片走到机房，从对话框走到工厂和马路，每往前一步，都需要有人把电、安全和工程这些不那么性感的问题，一件件解决掉。
